user.title: Librus Synergia (unofficial)
user.description: Log in with your Librus login (e.g. "1234567u") and password. This uses Librus's private web API and may violate Librus's Terms of Service - use your own account at your own risk. Your session normally expires after about a day with no way to silently renew it without your password, so - unlike some integrations - your password IS stored (alongside the session) to allow unattended daily refresh; it never leaves your Home Assistant instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Librus Synergia
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {login} could not be renewed. Enter the password again to log in.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Check the login/password.
error.captcha_needed: Librus is asking for a captcha, which this integration cannot solve automatically. Try again later, or log in once via the official Librus app/website first.
error.account_action_required: Your Librus account needs an action on Librus's own site first (accept rules, or change your password), then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Librus servers.

abort.already_configured: This Librus account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh grades, attendance, timetable and announcements. Keep this modest - it is an unofficial API.
data_description.messages_enabled: When off, the Unread messages sensor goes unavailable and no messages calls are made - fewer requests to Librus.
data_description.announcements_enabled: When off, the Unread announcements sensor goes unavailable and no SchoolNotices calls are made.
data_description.behaviour_grades_enabled: When off, the Behaviour grade sensor goes unavailable and no BehaviourGrades calls are made.
data_description.descriptive_grades_enabled: When off, the Descriptive grades sensor goes unavailable and no DescriptiveGrades calls are made.
data_description.free_days_enabled: When off, the Free days calendar entity is not created and no free-days calls are made.

school_year_rollover.title: School year end date looks out of date

confirm.title: Reload to re-check the school year
confirm.description: The cached school year end date ({end_date}) is over a month in the past. This usually updates automatically within 24 hours as Librus publishes the new school year's class record, but if it hasn't yet, reload the integration now to force an immediate re-check.

optional_endpoint_degraded.title: "{label}" has not responded in over a week
optional_endpoint_degraded.description: The optional "{label}" endpoint has failed on every attempt since {since}. This is often harmless - some schools don't enable every Librus module, and this integration already treats that as normal - but a full week of unbroken failures can also mean something changed (a permission change, or Librus reworking that endpoint). This is informational only and can be safely dismissed; it will reappear if the endpoint keeps failing.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Force an immediate data refresh instead of waiting for the next poll.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The student to refresh. Leave empty to refresh every configured student.

get_message.name: Get message
get_message.description: Fetches ONE message's full, untruncated content from Librus. This marks the message as read on Librus's servers, exactly like opening it in the Librus app or website - only call this for a message a person has actually chosen to open, never automatically or on a schedule.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The Librus Synergia device (student) to fetch the message from.

message_id.name: Message ID
message_id.description: The message's id, from the Unread messages sensor's "recent" attribute.

mailbox.name: Mailbox
mailbox.description: Which mailbox the message is in. Defaults to "inbox" - use "substitutions" or "alerts" for a message from the Unread messages sensor's "substitutions_recent" or "alerts_recent" attribute.
